title: Introducing Davis Steadman Percy & Sluka, LLC
body:
The law firm formerly known as Davis Steadman Ford & Percy, LLC announces that Susan Ford, of Woodstock, Vermont, is retiring after more than three decades of practice. Susan's area of professional activity focused on real estate work in Woodstock and the surrounding towns in the Upper Valley. During her many years of practice, Susan served on many professional and community boards and committees, including the District 3 Environmental Commission, the Woodstock Ski Runners Educational Program, and the Woodstock History Center, to name but a few. Susan's many clients were well served by her effective professional relationships with other attorneys, realtors, and officers at local mortgage lending institutions. We wish her well in her future retirement activities.

The firm will now be known as Davis Steadman Percy & Sluka, LLC, in recognition of the membership of Boolie Sluka and Justin Sluka. Boolie's primary area of practice is in family law and Justin represents injured clients in the area of Workers' Compensation. Both Boolie and Justin are admitted to practice in Vermont and New Hampshire.

Ben Percy continues to represent clients in Vermont real estate matters and Todd Steadman continues in general practice in the areas of family law, municipal law, probate matters, landlord/tenant, and general civil litigation.
